'''Nathan Carr''' (also published as '''Nate Carr''') is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2001 Mystic Visions tournament (first event)]] on 5 May 2001, according to Ted Panczyszyn's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2236">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-05-mystic-visions-columbia-pa-5-5-01d2236/ mystic-visions-columbia-pa-5-5-01], DeckTech (Ted "Rogue15" Panczyszyn, 5 May 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-05-mystic-visions-columbia-pa-5-5-01d2236/ GitHub Pages].</ref> He finished 6th at the [[April 2001 Lancaster tournament]] on 1 April 2001, according to Geoff Gallo-Cornell's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2003">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-02-lancaster-pa-4-2-01d2003/ lancaster-pa-4-2-01], DeckTech (Geoff "Loaf" Gallo-Cornell, 2 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-02-lancaster-pa-4-2-01d2003/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
